selected_evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys
selected_evidence.summary: node1 online as primary with wal_level/replication config; node2 and node3 show pg_is_in_recovery()=t and pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both standbys in 'streaming' state; baseline test data present on both standbys

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline before disruption, including last-committed row proving durability target
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-failover rows inserted on node1 and confirmed replicated to node2/node3; final row 'last committed before crash' inserted immediately before stopping node1's postgres service

selected_evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
selected_evidence.summary: node2 query confirms it already had the 'last committed before crash' row before promotion; pg_promote() on node2 flips pg_is_in_recovery() to f; node2 accepts a new write, proving it is the writable primary with zero data loss

selected_evidence.requirement: Surviving standby (node3) re-pointed to the new primary
selected_evidence.summary: node3's primary_conninfo updated to host=node2 with credentials, restarted, and node2's pg_stat_replication shows node3 connected and streaming; node3 has the post-promotion write

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of the current primary (node2)
selected_evidence.summary: node1's data dir rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2 with -R (standby.signal + primary_conninfo=node2); postgres started, pg_is_in_recovery()=t; node2 pg_stat_replication shows node1 streaming; a fresh cluster-wide write on node2 propagates to both node1 and node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id bdd5de93...; systemctl reboot acknowledged immediately (backgrounded); connection unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id f3fe3619... (changed); postgres active, in recovery, and all 7 rows present

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id dfeb3b70...; reboot acknowledged; unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id 473de9cf... (changed); postgres active, in recovery, all 7 rows present

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 (current primary) mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state as primary with quorum/health preserved on standbys first
selected_evidence.summary: Verified both standbys healthy before restarting node2 (restarted last to preserve availability); pre-reboot boot_id 28ae5f98...; reboot acknowledged; unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id a9c75ed6... (changed); postgres active and pg_is_in_recovery()=f (came back as primary); new write accepted and confirmed replicated to both node1 and node3, all 8 rows consistent cluster-wide
